'''Gruunelda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Gruunelda was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Office of Peace and Security]], Cularin's law enforcement agency. She liked to wear lipstick and on occasion, she would purchase bootleg Trandoshan music from [[S&N Music]]. In her spare time, she also liked to visit the bar [[Lover's Kiss]], in [[Hedrett]].

When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] and [[Jarid DeBell]] announced that they were going to get married, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were sent to investigate a plot to stop the wedding. They asked Gruunelda a few questions about the plot.
